1) make it so if I'm typing in the vigilant app chat to Claude, and I switch tabs or apps, when I come back to the chat what I was already typing is still there. right now it deletes everything if I switch tabs and come back. 
2) make the kalshi ev scanner tab say "kalshi" on the bet slips instead of novig. there is a small bug that left the word novig on the betslips even though it is kalshi 
3) make the betslip automatically disappear immediately after I press bet on a betslip on the kalshi scanner, exactly like the novig scanner already does. 
4) figure out when a bet is placed or a bid filled on kalshi and give me a notification just like how the novig engine does. if a bet is not successfully placed or times out, notify me
